Another game that doesn't currently have an entry in the WineHQ DB (probably because of its niche appeal) is Tokyo Xanadu eX. I found it when looking at other games made by the same developer as Trails of Cold Steel.

Unfortunately, Nihon Falcom will never port their games, so if you want to play them, Wine is your only option. It's a DX9 game, so no DXVK needed in this instance. Luckily the game runs perfectly fine with the right tweaks, which are listed below.

Wineprefix: 64bit Win 8.1 (7 will also work)

Wine Version: 3.13 Staging, with ESync patches (very important, because the game runs like shit without ESync). You could probably get away with a lower version of staging, the important factor is that it must have the ESync patches applied.

Winetricks: xact (all you need in terms of additional windows components, in order to play in-game cutscenes, without, you just get a black screen after the intro cutscene).

Environment Variables:

  • WINEESYNC = 1

And that's it. With Esync turned on, the game will not stutter and should run perfectly fine, providing you met the required hardware specs to run the game to begin with. As far as games go, this was a relatively easy one to get running, and if you are averse to Steam, or supporting a developer who refuses to support Linux, there are cracked version of this game out there on the high seas.
